title: Matterbridge Xiaomi MIoT
description: Xiaomi fans, air purifiers, lamps and Dreame robot vacuums over the local miIO/MIoT protocol

devices.description: The Xiaomi devices to expose over Matter.

name.description: The name shown in the controller app.

ip.description: The device IP address. Give the device a static lease on your router.

token.description: The 32 character device token. Extract it with https://github.com/PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor

model.description: The MIoT model, e.g. dmaker.fan.p18. Leave empty to ask the device.

deviceId.description: (Optional) The Xiaomi device id. Used as the Matter serial number, so setting it keeps the device identity stable.

pollingInterval.description: How often the device is polled, in seconds.

sensorsControl.description: Air purifier: expose air quality, PM2.5/PM10, temperature and humidity.

separateSensors.description: Air purifier: expose the sensors as their own device instead of child endpoints. Required for Apple Home.

filterControl.description: Air purifier: expose the remaining HEPA filter life.

speedControl.description: Air purifier: what the speed slider drives. "favorite" gives 12 steps, "levels" the 3 manual fan levels.

buzzerControl.description: Expose the beeper as a switch.

ledControl.description: Expose the display/indicator light as a switch.

childLockControl.description: Expose the physical controls lock as a switch.

modeControl.description: Expose the operating modes as switches (air purifier: auto/sleep/favorite/manual, fan: straight/natural wind).

swingControl.description: Fan: expose the oscillation as a separate switch (Apple Home otherwise hides it in the accessory settings).

ionizerControl.description: Air purifier: expose the ionizer as a switch.

sceneControl.description: Light: expose the built-in scenes as momentary switches. Not available on lamps that only speak the legacy Yeelight protocol.

roomIds.description: Vacuum: segment ids of the rooms to expose as service areas. Dreame robots cannot report their room list over MIoT, so list the ids from the Xiaomi Home app here.

roomNames.description: Vacuum: room names, in the same order as roomIds. Defaults to "Room <id>".

debug.description: Debug logging for this device only.

pollingInterval.description: The default polling interval for devices that do not set their own, in seconds.

whiteList.description: Only expose the devices listed here. Leave empty to expose all of them.

blackList.description: Never expose the devices listed here.

debug.description: Capture debug-level logging from this plugin, overriding the Matterbridge global log level setting.

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all exposed devices on shutdown (used for development/testing).
